reported_symptom: Donation remains paused while Cale installs or updates.
reproduced_cause: The desktop required every shared install-progress record to be complete, including optional runtime_features downloads that exhaust retries. It also treated missing progress and any waiting_for_setup task as permanent background-work holds. An optional failed record separately prevented the pending update from applying.
change: Donation and radio share the existing core-setup blocking policy. Optional installer status and stale waiting task rows do not suspend them. Update launch uses that same core-setup policy; existing live-worker checks still gate source updates.
preserved_guards: Donation opt-in, account binding, privacy modes and resource limits

validation.regression_before: 3 failed, 173 deselected on unchanged stable source
validation.combined_command: python -m pytest -q Validation/test_long_tasks.py Validation/test_donation.py Validation/test_donation_regressions.py Validation/test_runtime_features.py Validation/test_setup_recovery.py Validation/test_self_update.py Validation/test_radio_station.py --tb=short
coverage: Failed optional setup after three retries
Real DonationService pause-to-resume with unchanged consent

limitations: Client machine not directly inspected; this reproduces a confirmed cause matching the reported symptom.
Tests use fake contribution work and do not spend account allowances.
Old clients blocked by the old update guard may need to close Cale and run the new installer once.
